course.title: Igbo Language
course.tagline: Speak Igbo with confidence: greetings, tones and everyday talk.

days.title: Say ndewo and hello
days.goal: Greet people in Igbo and say goodbye.
steps: Watch today's video and repeat every example of greetings: ndewo, kedu, ka ọ dị, daalu out loud as you hear it.
Practise greetings: ndewo, kedu, ka ọ dị, daalu aloud for 10 minutes, slowly first, then at normal speed.
Write down five of your own examples using greetings: ndewo, kedu, ka ọ dị, daalu.
Record yourself practising greetings: ndewo, kedu, ka ọ dị, daalu and listen back, fixing any mistakes you hear.
Use greetings: ndewo, kedu, ka ọ dị, daalu in a real exchange today — with a friend, family member or language partner.

days.challenge: Greet someone in Igbo today, even by message.

quiz.q: What does 'ndewo' mean?
quiz.explain: 'Ndewo' means hello. It is the most common Igbo greeting.

quiz.explain: Today's lesson is about Say ndewo and hello — its goal is: Greet people in Igbo and say goodbye.

greetings: ndewo, kedu, ka ọ dị, daalu
